record.motion_hypothesis: M9 US Health Sciences: clock-hour attendance and Title IV evidence
record.segment: Private nonprofit college; under 1,000 students (781 fall 2025); Arkansas; undergraduate, graduate, and professional health sciences campuses
facts_carried_over: Anthony K. Grafton is Executive Vice President for Academic Affairs and Provost. Source: Lyon College Academic Services page, accessed 2026-09-03.
Lyon College reported 781 students at fall 2025 census, including 80 inaugural dental students. Source: Lyon College news release dated 2025-09-09.
The School of Dental Medicine opened in 2025 and welcomed its second cohort on 2026-07-21. Source: Lyon College news release dated 2026-07-21.
Dental students must attend lectures, laboratories, and clinics and report absences through a school attendance/absence website. Source: Lyon College Professional Catalog, accessed 2026-09-03.

The dental program is a continuous 36-month curriculum with didactic, simulation, and clinical coursework; clinical credit hours are tied to supervised instruction. Source: Lyon College Professional Catalog, accessed 2026-09-03.

The School of Veterinary Medicine completed an accreditation site visit scheduled for 2026-08-09 through 2026-08-13 and plans its first cohort for fall 2027 pending accreditation. Source: Lyon College news release dated 2026-01-30 and 2026-2027 Institute for Health Sciences Catalog, accessed 2026-09-03.
Lyon publicly exposes Canvas and a Jenzabar-powered myLYON portal. Source: myLYON portal, accessed 2026-09-03.
M9 requires confirmed clock-hour status, an identified attendance system of record, and a named owner before qualification. Source: ABM US Playbook v3.1, accessed 2026-09-03.
